scenarios.name: Hero Section Display
scenarios.description: Verify the hero section displays product name, tagline, logo, and primary value proposition prominently

steps.description: Navigate to the MirDB homepage URL
steps.context: User arrives at the homepage for the first time

steps.description: Check that the hero section contains product name (MirDB), tagline, and logo
steps.context: Hero section should be visible above the fold

steps.description: Check that 'Get Started' and 'View on GitHub' buttons are present and functional
steps.context: CTAs should be prominently displayed in the hero section

test_cases.input: Load homepage and inspect hero section
test_cases.expected: Product name 'MirDB' is displayed prominently
Tagline communicates persistent key-value store with memcached compatibility
Logo image is displayed and has appropriate alt text
Scrolls to or navigates to quick-start section
Opens GitHub repository in new tab

scenarios.name: Value Propositions Section
scenarios.description: Verify the three key value propositions (persistence, memcached compatibility, Rust) are clearly displayed

steps.description: Scroll to the value propositions section of the homepage
steps.context: Section should be visible after the hero section

steps.description: Check that all three key differentiators are displayed: persistent storage, memcached compatibility, written in Rust
steps.context: Each value proposition should have a title and description

test_cases.expected: Section displays 'Persistent Storage' value proposition with description
Section displays 'Memcached Compatible' value proposition with description
Section displays 'Written in Rust' value proposition with description
Value propositions are displayed in a 3-column layout on desktop

scenarios.name: Features Section
scenarios.description: Verify the features section highlights core capabilities including LSM Tree architecture, Async I/O, configuration, and compaction

steps.description: Scroll to or click navigation to reach the features section
steps.context: Features section should be accessible from navigation

steps.action: Verify all core features are listed
steps.description: Check that LSM Tree Architecture, Async I/O with Tokio, Configurable Parameters, and Background Compaction are displayed
steps.context: Each feature should have a title and description

test_cases.input: Check features section for LSM Tree
test_cases.expected: LSM Tree Architecture feature is displayed with description

test_cases.input: Check features section for Async I/O
test_cases.expected: Async I/O with Tokio feature is displayed with description
Configurable Parameters feature is displayed with description
Background Compaction feature is displayed with description

scenarios.name: Quick Start Guide
scenarios.description: Verify the quick-start guide provides installation and basic usage commands that enable users to run MirDB within 5 minutes

steps.description: Scroll to or click navigation to reach the quick-start guide section
steps.context: Quick-start should be prominently accessible

steps.description: Check that installation commands (cargo install or build from source) are provided
steps.context: Commands should be in code blocks with syntax highlighting

steps.description: Check that basic usage examples (connecting, set/get commands) are provided
steps.context: Examples should demonstrate memcached protocol compatibility

test_cases.expected: Installation command 'cargo install mirdb' or equivalent is displayed

test_cases.input: Check quick-start for build from source instructions
test_cases.expected: Git clone and cargo build commands are displayed
Command to run MirDB binary is displayed

test_cases.input: Check quick-start for client connection example
test_cases.expected: Example showing how to connect with memcached client (telnet localhost 12333)
Example showing SET and GET commands with expected output

test_cases.input: Verify code blocks have syntax highlighting
test_cases.expected: Code blocks display with proper syntax highlighting for bash/shell commands

scenarios.name: Memcached Commands Reference
scenarios.description: Verify supported memcached commands are documented with examples

steps.description: Scroll to or expand the commands reference section
steps.context: Section may be collapsible as per PRD

steps.description: Check that GET, SET, DELETE and other commands are documented with examples
steps.context: Commands should include syntax and example usage

test_cases.input: Check commands section for storage commands
test_cases.expected: SET, ADD, REPLACE, APPEND, PREPEND commands are documented

test_cases.input: Check commands section for retrieval commands
test_cases.expected: GET and GETS commands are documented

test_cases.input: Check commands section for DELETE command
test_cases.expected: DELETE command is documented

test_cases.input: Check commands section for MirDB-specific commands
test_cases.expected: INFO and MAJOR_COMPACTION commands are documented

test_cases.input: Verify command examples include code snippets
test_cases.expected: Each command has a code example with syntax highlighting

scenarios.name: Configuration Documentation
scenarios.description: Verify configuration parameters are documented with descriptions and defaults

steps.description: Find the configuration documentation on the page
steps.context: Configuration may be in quick-start or separate section

steps.description: Check that common configuration parameters are documented with defaults
steps.context: Should include addr, max_level, work_dir, sst_max_size, mem_table_max_size, block_size

test_cases.input: Check configuration section for addr parameter
test_cases.expected: addr parameter documented with default '0.0.0.0:12333'

test_cases.input: Check configuration section for max_level parameter
test_cases.expected: max_level parameter documented with default '7'

test_cases.input: Check configuration section for work_dir parameter
test_cases.expected: work_dir parameter documented with default '/tmp/mirdb'

test_cases.input: Check configuration section for size parameters
test_cases.expected: sst_max_size, mem_table_max_size, block_size parameters documented with defaults

test_cases.input: Verify configuration example in TOML format
test_cases.expected: Complete TOML configuration example is displayed with syntax highlighting

steps.context: Content should stack vertically and be readable

steps.description: Verify navigation is accessible (hamburger menu or similar)

scenarios.name: Page Performance

test_cases.expected: Lighthouse performance score >= 80

steps.context: All interactive elements must be keyboard accessible

test_cases.expected: No critical accessibility issues reported
All text meets 4.5:1 contrast ratio minimum
All interactive elements are focusable and operable via keyboard

test_cases.input: Check for alt text on images

Headings follow proper hierarchy (h1, h2, h3) without skipping levels
